name: WSSC Water
notes: Researched from public wsscwater.com pages and the public My WSSC Water login page (no sign-in). The login form asks for User ID (an email address; there is a Change User ID (Email Address) link) and Password; Bill Pay (Guest Mode) makes a one-time payment without an account. Residential card payments carry a $1.69 convenience fee and are limited to $750 per transaction and four per month (the per-transaction card cap cannot be modelled because the engine requires maxPaymentCents >= $5,000); ACH/e-check through e-Bill is free. E-Z Pay direct debit drafts checking or savings on the payment date printed on each bill ; e-Bill Auto Pay pays future bills with the payment option chosen at enrollment, which may be a card through Quick Payment Options, so AutoPay is modelled with bank and card methods on the due date (the municipal-portal template cannot hide card entry on its AutoPay page anyway; reported as a cross-owner request). Bills are quarterly; a 5% late fee applies if payment is not scheduled before the due date. Flexible Pay Plans (interest-free, through Promise) can be started online or by phone by eligible residential customers. Start/Stop Service is an online form to submit within 10 business days of moving.

help.title: Pay My Bill
paragraphs: Pay online in My WSSC Water, as a guest with Bill Pay (Guest Mode), in the WSSC Water mobile app with your 10-digit account number and ZIP code, or through your own bank's online bill pay.

Residential card payments (app, phone or in person) carry a $1.69 convenience fee, are limited to $750 per payment and four payments per account each month. Paying by ACH e-check through e-Bill is free.
Pay by phone 24/7 through the automated system at 301-206-4001.
By mail, send a check for one account to WSSC Water, PO Box 62135, Baltimore, MD 21264-2135. Do not mail cash.
A 5% late fee applies if your payment is not scheduled before the bill's due date.

help.title: E-Z Pay direct debit
paragraphs: E-Z Pay takes your bill amount from your checking or savings account on the payment date printed on each bill. Registration asks for an image of a check.

If you choose Auto Pay when enrolling in e-Bill, future bills are paid automatically, but a bill that is already unpaid is not; use Pay Now for it. You can set, change or cancel a payment limit at any time.
steps: Log in to My WSSC Water.
Choose your checking or savings account.
Authorize the payment date and amount.

help.title: e-Bill
paragraphs: With e-Bill you get an email each quarter when a new bill is ready. Enrolling is required for free electronic check payments; card payments carry a fee.
Activation can take up to one billing cycle, and only one user per billing account may register. You can cancel e-Bill at any time from Account Management.

help.title: Flexible Pay Plans and assistance
paragraphs: Flexible Pay Plans are interest-free payment plans offered through Promise to eligible residential customers. Sign up online or by phone.
WSSC Water also offers a Customer Assistance Program for income-eligible customers and the Water Fund. For help call 301-206-4001 on weekdays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

help.title: Start or stop service
paragraphs: Use the online Start/Stop Service form and choose a date close to your settlement or move date. Submit it within 10 business days of moving so a meter reading can be arranged if needed.
If you have an inside meter, include the reading on the form. To move between properties, complete both the stop form and the start form.
steps: Enter the stop date and any inside meter reading.
